from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

# Login Gmail
gmail_pw = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail')
gmail_login = apis.gmail.login(username='br_ritt@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)
access_token = gmail_login['access_token']

# Fetch the Rome flight confirmation thread (we previously found thread 47821)
thread_id = 47821
th = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=access_token)

# Extract schedule line "confirmed for YYYY-MM-DD|HH:MM:SS" from body
body = th['emails'][0]['body']
match = re.search(r'confirmed for\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\|(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})', body)
print('thread_subject', th['emails'][0]['subject'])
print('extracted_match', match.groups() if match else None)

flight_date = match.group(1)
flight_time = match.group(2)
flight_dt = datetime.strptime(f'{flight_date} {flight_time}', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
alarm_dt = flight_dt - timedelta(hours=2, minutes=30)

print('flight_dt', flight_dt)
print('alarm_dt', alarm_dt)
print('alarm_time_HHMM', alarm_dt.strftime('%H:%M'))
print('alarm_time_seconds', alarm_dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S'))

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

# 1) Fetch Rome flight confirmation email and extract flight date/time
# Gmail auth
gmail_pw = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail')
gmail_login = apis.gmail.login(username='br_ritt@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)
gmail_access_token = gmail_login['access_token']

thread_id = 47821  # Flight Ticket for Rome
th = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=gmail_access_token)
email = th['emails'][0]
body = email['body']

match = re.search(r'confirmed for\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\|(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})', body)
assert match, 'Could not extract flight date/time from confirmation email.'
flight_date = match.group(1)
flight_time = match.group(2)
flight_dt = datetime.strptime(f'{flight_date} {flight_time}', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

# 2.5 hours before
alarm_dt = flight_dt - timedelta(hours=2, minutes=30)
alarm_time_hhmm = alarm_dt.strftime('%H:%M')
alarm_repeat_day = alarm_dt.strftime('%A').lower()  # e.g., 'monday'
label = 'Flight to Rome'

# 2) Inspect existing alarms to ensure no exact duplicate at same time
phone_pw = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone')
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='8739267917', password=phone_pw)
phone_access_token = phone_login['access_token']

alarms=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=phone_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    alarms.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

same_time = [a for a in alarms if str(a.get('time'))==alarm_time_hhmm]
same_label_time = [a for a in alarms if a.get('label')==label and str(a.get('time'))==alarm_time_hhmm]

print('Task criteria:', "Add a phone alarm with label 'Flight to Rome' 2.5 hours before scheduled flight day/time as per its confirmation email")
print('Parsed from confirmation email:')
print('  flight_dt =', flight_dt)
print('  alarm_dt  =', alarm_dt)
print('Computed alarm payload:')
print('  time =', alarm_time_hhmm)
print('  repeat_days =', [alarm_repeat_day])
print('  label =', label)
print('Existing alarms at same time:', len(same_time))
print('Existing alarms with same label+time:', len(same_label_time))
print('Example existing alarm at same time (if any):', same_time[0] if same_time else None)
